title: Two actual gradient flows contract under nonnegative curvature
source_anchor: Chewi arXiv:2605.07006v1 Definition1.5, Proposition1.6 (1.5), Section2 GF and Theorem2.2
target_statement: For nonnegative alpha and differentiable alpha-convex f on a complete real Hilbert space, two supplied forward gradient flows on [0,T] satisfy norm(Yt-Xt)<=exp(-alpha*t)*norm(Y0-X0).
